plate_findings.evidence: visual - pale xanthomatous infiltration on low-power; in-text: "Clusters and sheets of xanthomatous macrophages were present within the submucosa and infiltrated the lymphoid parenchyma. (Fig. 1)"

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Low-power histopathology of tonsillectomy specimen from Patient 1 in Tangier Disease article; shows foamy pale infiltration corresponding to xanthomatous macrophages described for Fig.1, hallmark of Tangier disease. B: High-power tonsil histopathology directly captioned as clusters/sheets of xanthomatous macrophages, hallmark of Tangier disease, in Tangier Disease article patient specimen.
panels.attribution_text: Sasidharan Pillai et al. Tangier Disease.. Current atherosclerosis reports 2026. doi:10.1007/s11883-026-01457-5. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 1.
panels.figure_caption: A and B. Histopathology findings of tonsillectomy specimen of Patient 1. (A) Low-power magnification showing relative preservation of follicular architecture with follicular hyperplasia of tonsils. (B) High-power magnification revealing clusters and sheets of xanthomatous macrophages in the submucosa and infiltrating within the lymphoid parenchyma, a hallmark finding in Tangier disease
in_text_mentions: body macrophages. Clusters and sheets of xanthomatous macrophages were present within the submucosa and infiltrated the lymphoid parenchyma.
